title: HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record
abstract: arXiv:2610.00984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate medication recommendation is central to clinical decision-making, directly determining therapeutic efficacy and patient safety. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: drugs are often abstracted as discrete tokens, ignoring their molecular structures and pharmacological mechanisms, and the commonly used "flat" recommendation paradigm fails to leverage the hierarchical logic of the internationally standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system. To address these issues, we propose HADRec, a Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation framework that integrates molecular knowledge with electronic health records (EHRs). translated_title: HADRec：一个融合分子知识与电子健康档案的层次感知药物推荐框架
translated_abstract: 准确的药物推荐是临床决策的核心，直接决定治疗效果和患者安全。然而，现有方法存在两个关键局限：药物常被抽象为离散的标记，忽略了其分子结构和药理机制；常用的“扁平”推荐范式未能利用国际标准化的解剖学治疗学化学（ATC）分类系统的层次逻辑。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了HADRec，一个将分子知识与电子健康档案（EHR）相融合的层次感知药物推荐框架。HADRec采用LLaMA-7B对临床记录进行编码以获得丰富的患者表示，并使用ChemBERTa对药物的简化分子线性输入规范（SMILES）字符串进行编码，构建全局分子知识库。然后通过交叉注意力机制在两者之间进行深度多模态融合
tldr: 提出了HADRec框架，通过融合分子知识（利用ChemBERTa编码药物分子结构）与电子健康档案信息（利用LLaMA-7B编码临床记录），并引入ATC分类系统的层次逻辑，提升药物推荐的准确性。
en_tdlr: HADRec, a hierarchy-aware drug recommendation framework, fuses molecular knowledge encoded by ChemBERTa with patient representations from LLaMA-7B-encoded clinical notes, leveraging the hierarchical logic of the ATC classification system to improve medication recommendation accuracy.
